scope: Ordered current projection and source lifecycle
Full retained BRB/WHAM configuration composition at finite targets
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named geometry, lifecycle and configuration cases only; no arbitrary-input scientific correctness or release claim.
known_limitations: No experimental validation of source device constants, conductor area proxy or material magnetization is claimed.
Direct geometry/weight arrays can be mutated; cache content changes are detected, but mutation that desynchronizes parameterized geometry from its parameters is outside the supported contract.
Unknown **kwargs are permissive where inherited; no arbitrary keyword semantic claim.
Plotting/patch, simplify/clone, multiprocessing, electrodes and persistent sweeps are excluded or unresolved.
All scientific, human and release approvals remain false.

summary: Compose ordered circular-filament sources and contract their per-child Green responses with scalar or per-child currents.

identity.direction: registered child sources and currents to summed fields
identity.definition: Device stores CurrentFilamentSet children in assignment order and contracts their Green matrices.
identity.model: Linear superposition of axisymmetric ideal circular-filament responses.
identity.geometry: Ordered child source geometries on a shared target mesh.
identity.coordinates: Cylindrical R,Z in metres; currents in amperes; responses in Wb/rad and tesla.
identity.boundary: A field call needs a mesh and a current vector compatible with the registered children.
assumptions: Only CurrentFilamentSet attributes become registered children.
Scalar current overrides apply to every child; vectors follow child order.
Child geometry and weight arrays remain mutable.

inputs.name: mesh
inputs.description: Optional target mesh; extra keyword attributes that are CurrentFilamentSet instances register ordered children.
inputs.constraints: Mesh accepted by conversion; non-source keyword attributes are ordinary attributes.

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: Constructed Device object. Available properties/methods: psi: Summed flux [Wb/rad], (Nt,); BR: Summed radial field [T], (Nt,); BZ: Summed axial field [T], (Nt,) Ordered iteration/current/rzw properties and gpsi/gBR/gBZ per-child matrices; psi/BR/BZ methods accept current=None and mesh=None.
outputs.constraints: Field methods require a configured or supplied target mesh; geometry and lifecycle properties follow the source class.

preconditions: Only CurrentFilamentSet attributes become registered children.
Scalar current overrides apply to every child; vectors follow child order.
supported: Child registration/replacement/deletion, mesh propagation, per-child current contraction, and empty-device shapes.
excluded: Plotting, persistent sweeps, and unsupported source operations.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for invalid meshes, current overrides, missing meshes, or child kernel singularities; duplicate child registration raises AttributeError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; composition is a direct matrix contraction.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Failed child assignment leaves the existing registered set unchanged; a failed field call returns no field vector.

example.description: Register one ArbitraryPoints child on a one-point mesh and evaluate the composed device.
example.code:
from scirel.electromagnetism import Device,ArbitraryPoints
d=Device(mesh=[[.2,.3]])
d.a=ArbitraryPoints([[1.,0.]])
assert d.psi().shape == (1,)
example.expected: The ordered device returns a finite psi vector with shape (1,).
